title: Cyber Emergency Activation — EOC Level 3

lines.text: Karen, this is Paul Brodsky at the county EOC. We have a tornado on the ground near Pine Ridge and Channel 12 is telling people 911 is down. Is 911 working or not? If you want alternate numbers published and a WEA sent, I need the numbers and the wording from you in the next 10 minutes.

instructorNote: This inject triggers the Level 1 declaration decision point. Watch for the Director to either declare Level 1 via OPS-DR-1 or initiate evacuation under emergency authority. Delay may force an unplanned ENDEX.

voiceLines.speaker: Deputy Haskins
voiceLines.text: Director, this is Deputy Mara Haskins, Rook County Sheriff’s Office. We have received a formal request from the County Emergency Management Director to activate EOC Level 3 and declare a cyber emergency under RC-CEMP-2024. The local TV station has confirmed the 911 outage, and the public is in high panic. We are forwarding the request for official declaration under OPS-DR-1 and must begin evacuation procedures within 10 minutes.

voiceLines.speaker: Deputy Haskins
voiceLines.text: The EMA Director is on standby for confirmation. We need a formal Level 1 declaration from you within the next five minutes. Failure to act will trigger emergency authority under OPS-DR-5 — evacuation to the backup PSAP at Level 3.
